missions.title: The Hospital Slip
missions.description: During a routine late-night check-in, the player catches Walter White fully alert, whispering frantically into a hidden burner cell phone. Before Walter can react, footsteps echo down the corridor—Hank Schrader is arriving for an unscheduled late-night family visit to check on Walt's recovery. Walter desperately needs the player to help him hide the phone and maintain his facade of a confused, semi-conscious patient.

metadata.stakes: If Walter's faked fugue state is exposed to Hank, the DEA will immediately link him to the investigation, bringing his entire criminal enterprise to a premature end.
metadata.decision_option_1: Help Walter hide the burner phone under his mattress and tell Hank that Walter has been sleeping peacefully all night.
metadata.decision_option_2: Subtly draw Hank's attention to the hidden phone, exposing Walter's active state of mind and putting his cover at immediate risk.
metadata.decision_option_3: Quietly confiscate the phone yourself, promising Walter you will keep his secret in exchange for future leverage or financial compensation.

objectives.description: Decide how to handle Walter's hidden phone and the sudden arrival of his DEA brother-in-law.

checkpoints.title: The Hospital Slip resolved

world_rule_1.statement: High-purity methamphetamine production relies on advanced chemistry, utilizing specialized equipment and hard-to-acquire chemical precursors like methylamine to bypass standard restrictions.

world_rule_2.statement: The local drug market is highly volatile, drawing immediate and lethal attention from violent street gangs, regional distributors, Mexican cartels, and the Drug Enforcement Administration.
